🇳🇵 Nepal is truly a land of extraordinary contrasts! From the mighty Himalayas and legendary Sherpas to ancient traditions, living goddesses, and dangerous honey hunters, this country is full of surprises.
But what surprised you the most about Nepal? The extreme mountain lifestyle, unusual marriage traditions, or the incredible strength of its people?
💬 Let us know your favorite discovery in the comments!
